findings.title: Full database CI fails on stale rollback-head expectations
findings.description: The full database suite invoked by .github/workflows/db.yml exits 1 at tested_commit: 237 passed, 1 failed. test_populated_downgrade_fails_before_guard_or_acl_changes correctly observes the failed downgrade rolling back to e8c2f1a6b904, but its two expected-version expressions still use REVISION=d4c1a9e7b203. The first assertion stops the remaining trigger, lookup, ACL and subject/binding checks. All thirteen exact packet checks pass and the BLOCKED/PASS/UNMERGED result accurately separates that fact from failing supplemental CI. The excluded test remains byte-identical to protected master; neither the unapplied patch nor candidate-only in-memory probe closes the CI failure.
findings.required_change: Obtain narrow governance scope or a separately authorized repair for exactly the two expected-head expressions at lines 1596 and 1619. Preserve every downgrade exception, trigger, lookup, ACL, namespace and principal-binding assertion and all other bytes. Integrate the authorized scope, apply the repair, rerun all thirteen exact task checks and full CI regressions on a new tested revision, commit the new result/evidence and obtain fresh SHA-bound GENERAL, PROTOCOL and DB_CONCURRENCY reviews. Do not waive, skip or weaken CI or frozen uniqueness.
